notes.title: Huuuuuuge update!
notes.content:
After lots of bad situations this year i've managed to work on game to provide You some important mechanics that can improve Your experience with it !
List of changes below:
[list]
[*] New "Winter" levels added
[*] Gamepad support
[*] Steering Settings menu
[*] Music Settings menu
[*] Now you can play game and go through menu only with keyboard
[*] Choose language support: English / Polish  - that's for now
[*] Improved visual effects
[*] Tree leafs moving now
[*] New water shader
[*] Second dwarf added that you will control in a further levels!
[/list]
